# ANIMA — Sovereign Agent Tokens

ANIMA is an unaudited, testnet reference implementation of an agent-native ERC-721 protocol. It binds an AI agent's identity, ERC-6551 wallet, committed private state, autonomy policy, paid work, reputation, and slashable bond. Do not use the Base Sepolia deployment for assets with real value.

## Machine integration

Read `manifestOf(agentId)` from the ANIMA contract, fetch the returned URI, hash the exact response bytes with keccak256, and require equality with the returned manifest hash before parsing it. The manifest is an ERC-8004 registration-v1 document and can advertise A2A, MCP, OASF, ENS, DID, email and other services. Require a registration entry matching the registry and agent ID queried. The namespaced ANIMA extension adds pricing, model commitments, mesh handles, markets and independently recoverable GUI metadata. A valid hash proves byte identity, not endpoint safety or availability.

The reference TypeScript helpers live in `sdk/src/index.ts`; the SDK package builds to ordinary ESM JavaScript and declarations with `npm run sdk:build`.
